# react.useanimations.com, where the v3 site lived before it moved here (a domain alias of the
# Netlify site).
https://react.useanimations.com/*  https://useanimations.com/:splat  301!

# Pages of the previous site (www and http are redirected by Netlify). Trailing slashes, .html
# pages and the aliases below are redirected first by netlify/edge-functions/canonical-url.ts;
# these rules are the fallback.
/index.html                   /                     301!
/documentation.html           /documentation        301!
/licencing-and-terms.html     /licencing-and-terms  301!
/zh.html                      /zh                   301!

# The all-icons index: icons/ is also the folder of the icon files, so serve icons.html explicitly.
/icons                        /icons.html           200!

# Other spellings of pages.
/docs                         /documentation        301!
/license                      /licencing-and-terms  301!
/licence                      /licencing-and-terms  301!
/licensing                    /licencing-and-terms  301!
/licensing-and-terms          /licencing-and-terms  301!

# Images of the previous site.
/images/OGuseAnimationsImage.jpg  /og.png                301
/images/apple-touch-icon.png      /apple-touch-icon.png  301
/images/favicon-32x32.png         /favicon.ico           301
/images/favicon-16x16.png         /favicon.ico           301
/images/safari-pinned-tab.svg     /favicon.svg           301
/images/logo-useanimations.svg    /favicon.svg           301
